lints.name: auth_rls_initplan

lints.description: Detects if calls to \`current_setting()\` and \`auth.<function>()\` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row

findings.detail: Table \`public.opportunities\` has a row level security policy \`Admin gerencia oportunidades\` that re-evaluates current_setting() or auth.<function>() for each row.
